title: Hamnet Shakespeare, who has died in Stratford that his namesake may live for ever
html_source:
Shakespeare’s son who died at 11, so, in Stephen’s non-platonic view the subsequent grief served as inspiration for the play Hamlet.

Note that Rudy would be 11 if he had lived.
